newsitem.title: USA: Novatek says to issue statement Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Novatek says to issue statement Tuesday.

text.p: Novatek International Inc will issue a statement on Tuesday afternoon about the Securities and Exchange Commission's decision to suspend trading in the company's stock, a Novatek spokesman said.
Spokesman Anthony Sebro told Reuters Novatek would issue a brief statement about the suspension and a "fuller statement will come in a day or so."
The SEC said it suspended trade in the Columbia, Md., company because of questions about the accuracy of the company's information. Trade will remain suspended until midnight on Oct 28.
Sebro also said president Gaston Oxman was returning to the United States from a trip to South America. Novatek markets and distributes rapid medical testing devices in Latin America.
